brief: North Macedonia's banking sector is overwhelmingly foreign-owned, so the richest English-language disclosure about MK banks sits abroad: NLB Group (Ljubljana) publishes an explicit North Macedonia market segment, ProCredit Holding (Frankfurt) folds MK into a South-Eastern Europe segment plus CRR country-by-country tables, Türkiye Halk Bankası fully consolidates Halk Banka AD Skopje, Steiermärkische Sparkasse (Graz) owns the merged Sparkasse+Ohridska entity, CCB Sofia/Chimimport owns CCB Skopje, and NBG remains the parent of Stopanska Banka. The best-verified channels this run are the NLB, ProCredit and Halkbank IR sites; the weakest are Steiermärkische (no annual-report PDF located) and NBG (IR path inferred only), and Silk Road Bank's Swiss private owner has no IR channel at all. Exchange disclosure platforms upstream of these parents — LJSE SEOnet, KAP, the Bulgarian exchange — plus MSE issuer pages and the NBRM bank registry are the highest-value pointer layer for catching ownership and capital events before they reach IR pages.
